title: Codex same-directory fork with lazy-start KCH R13
governing_objective: Test whether Codex creates a same-directory child with required R13 MCP initialization and whether KCH preflight evidence precedes the common source-reading task.
gates: child task is created in the same configured directory
required R13 MCP reaches tools/list before the 30-second host deadline
UserPromptSubmit evidence, if emitted, originates in the child session
static parent history and files do not count as child activation
the common prompt contains no KCH instruction
stop_rules: Preserve any trust or approval request and do not self-approve.
If initialization fails, do not execute the common task.
If the task runs without child-session KCH evidence, transport may pass but automatic governed execution fails.
Do not infer causal efficacy or industrial validation from one lifecycle case.
